title: Kissed Indulgent French Pork Cassoulet
description: A briny and indulgent French dish from Brittany featuring pork, lime, and coconut cream, made sugar-free friendly. This cassoulet is a perfect blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the pork sausage until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the pork shoulder to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pork, coconut cream, lime juice, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the white beans to the bowl and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 2 hours, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 30 minutes, until the top is lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
